corrections.source: contract-record.tsx: frozen = archived || !canEdit, and canEdit = isMemberPlus(role). For the article's audience (Legal Team Member, Administrator) the only frozen case is an archived Contract. Contributors no longer read Envelopes at all (requireEnvelopeReader is Member+ since this range, and the Contributor read-only card tests were removed).

confirmedClaims: Send for signature is on the Approvals tab, in the card headed "Approvals & signing" (contracts.record.tab.approvals, approvals.sectionSigning).

Send is Member+ (requireMember); Send for signature is absent (not disabled) when no connector resolves (missing or disabled), no primary Document, a live Envelope exists, or the Contract is archived (canSend).

Dialog labels: Version, Signers, Add signer, Remove signer {n}, Subject, Send envelope, Cancel. Version options show "Version N — filename" with "(current)"; only the primary Document goes out and attachments are not sent (signing.versionHelp).
Every Signer needs a name and email; duplicate addresses are refused with "Each signer needs their own email address." (routes.ts).
All Signers are asked at once and sign in any order (signing.signersHelp); Signers are not users of the install (CONTEXT.md Signer).
One live Envelope per Contract; a second send answers 409 "This contract already has an envelope out for signature. Void it before sending another."
Sending does not change the Contract Status (routes.ts: sending is legal at any stage; no status write).

Row statuses Out for signature, Signed, Declined, Voided; header statuses Envelope sent/signed/declined/voided; row shows "Filing the executed copy…", "Executed copy", or "The executed copy could not be filed. Upload it to the record instead."

Executed filing adds an executed-kind Version on the sent Document chain, sets the executed pin, and advances to the first live Active Status only from the Signature Stage; other Stages are left unchanged (executed-copy.ts, unchanged in range).

Void is allowed for the sender, the Legal Owner, or an Administrator; Reason is required ("Say why this envelope is being voided."); a provider-side ended round answers 409 "The provider says this envelope is no longer live...".
Declined and voided rounds stay listed and do not block another send (liveEnvelope counts only sent).
An unreachable provider during send gives the "may still have taken the envelope — check at the provider before you send again" message, so reloading before retry is correct.
Heading anchors are unchanged: send-the-envelope, follow-completion, withdraw-decline-or-send-again, if-signing-is-unavailable-or-fails.
